result.stdout:
Usage:
  deppoc --server                         run this user's server (exits 0 at once when one runs)
  deppoc --stop                           stop the running server
  deppoc --stats [--since <yyyy-MM-dd>] [--format text|json]
                                          what the running server holds and the runs it recorded
  deppoc lint <sln|slnx|csproj> [-c <configuration>] [--min-level hidden|info|warning|error]
              [--format text|json|sarif] [--output <file>] [--progress auto|plain|off]
  deppoc build <sln|slnx|csproj> [--output <folder>] [-c <configuration>] [--no-analyzers] [--no-hardlinks]
              [--progress auto|plain|off]
                                          in place (apps and tests in their own bin, as dotnet build), or into
                                          the folder
  deppoc test  <sln|slnx|csproj> [-c <configuration>] [--all] [--parallel <n>] [--max-failures <n>] [--queue]
              [--exclude <project name, * for any text>]... [--output <folder>] [--no-analyzers] [--format text|json|trx] [--report <file>]
              [--progress auto|plain|off] [-- <test arguments>]

Progress goes to the standard error, at most a line a second: coloured on a terminal, plain lines when redirected
or with NO_COLOR (auto), or always plain, or none. The standard output is the report's.
  deppoc clear <sln|slnx|csproj> [-c <configuration>]
  deppoc clear --all                      deppoc's caches of every worktree (the server is stopped first)
